entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... um... I need to make a return. It's for the VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and the order number, please?
Yes, the name is Sarah Miller. The order number is... VF789012. I've just been a loyal customer for so long, and I feel awful about this, but I really need the money back.

I understand, Sarah. Thank you for that information. I see you received the VeloBand 17 days ago. Just so I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?

Oh, it works fine. It's just... it's not for me. It's a bit complicated on my wrist and I thought I'd use it more. With things being so tight financially, I just can't justify keeping it if I'm not using it every single day.
That's completely understandable, sometimes a device just doesn't fit into your routine as expected. Let me just pull up our current return policy to see what the options are. One moment.
Okay... I hope it's not a problem.

Alright, Sarah, I've checked the policy. It looks like you have nothing to worry about. You are well within our 90-day return window, so I can go ahead and process this for a full refund for you right now.
Oh! Really? Oh, thank you so much, Isaac! That is such a huge relief. I was so worried it would be too late.

Not at all, you're well within the timeframe. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file for you right now. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
That is wonderful. Thank you, you've really helped me out today. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
